items.heading: Search Around for Cost
items.text: Search around for cost and the numbers you find will look inconsistent, because providers structure pricing very differently rather than because the underlying service varies that much. Broadly, cost tends to fall into a few patterns.

items.heading: A Handful of Structural Choices
items.text: A handful of structural choices explain most of the spread in cost, more than provider "quality" does on its own.

items.heading: A Higher Price Is Not
items.text: A higher price is not automatic proof of better guidance, and a free or low price is not automatic proof of weaker guidance. What the fee should buy is structured decision support, not just time on a call.

items.heading: Billed Separately, Often the Largest
items.text: Billed separately, often the largest single line item before counselling even starts.

items.heading: Bundled in or Clearly Itemised,
items.text: Bundled in or clearly itemised, so the paid portion is the actual guidance conversation.
